title: Galaxy Code
intro: Space station Aurora has lost its power. The repair droid **Bip** will collect the crystals if you build a program for it from blocks, from simple commands to nested repeats. New planets unlock one by one.
noEditorText: The block editor couldn’t be loaded. Refresh the page. If that doesn’t help, tell your teacher.
tt.start: The start of the program. The blocks under it run from top to bottom.
tt.forward: The ship flies one cell in the direction it faces
tt.collect: Pick up the crystal on the cell where the ship is standing
tt.repeat: Run the blocks inside several times
problem.allowed: This level doesn’t have the “{name}” block yet. Remove it from your program.
problem.forbidden: The “{name}” block isn’t allowed in this level. The extra blocks are highlighted.
problem.limit: Too many “{name}” blocks: you can use only {limit}, but your program has {count}. The extra blocks are highlighted.
problem.limitForward: Too many “{name}” blocks: you can use only {limit}, but your program has {count}. Try the “🔁 repeat” block. The extra blocks are highlighted.
problem.max: Too many blocks: the maximum is {max}, but your program has {count}. Try to shorten it with repeats. The extra blocks are highlighted.
problem.depth: Repeats can be nested at most {max} levels deep.
problem.repn: A repeat must run from {min} to {max} times.
ready: Build a program from blocks and press “Run”.
runningLoose: Running the program… (Grey blocks outside the program are not run.)
stopped: Stopped. The ship is back at the start.
resetDone: The ship is back at the start. You can change the program and try again.
emptyLoose: The blocks aren’t attached to “▶ when started” (they are grey). Drag them under the start block until they snap on.
emptyProgram: The program is empty. Drag blocks from the panel on the left under “▶ when started”.
crashRock: 💥 Crash at {block} (counting from the top): the ship hit an asteroid. Check this block and try again.
crashEdge: 💥 Crash at {block} (counting from the top): the ship flew off the board. Check this block and try again.
noCrystal: ❌ There’s no crystal here! {block} ran on an empty cell. Collect a crystal only when the ship is standing on it.
incomplete: The program has ended. Collected {collected} of {total}. Add more commands and try again.
win: ✅ Level complete! Blocks in your program: {blocks}. Stars: {stars}.
tailPerfect: Perfect: exactly as many blocks as needed!

tailBetter.one: The shortest program has {count} block. Can you make yours shorter?
tailBetter.other: The shortest program has {count} blocks. Can you make yours shorter?

finalText: Bip collected all the crystals, and station Aurora shines again. Stars on the map: {stars} of {total}. {tail}
improve: Improve your program: try to make it shorter.
